infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: WinLock discovers your Windows laptop on the local network and sends encrypted commands to it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: WinLock scans the pairing QR code shown on your Windows laptop.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: WinLock uses Face ID to authorize privileged actions such as locking your laptop.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: WinLock advertises your presence over Bluetooth so the laptop can detect when you are nearby. Bluetooth is only a proximity signal and never grants access by itself.
